name: origami.publica.la
description: Through this connector Claude works inside a publisher's Origami workspace: list publications, files and metadata; upload new books; run validation and quality tools (epubcheck, Ace by DAISY accessibility, metadata extraction, ONIX export, format conversion); and read the reports those tools produce — with the same permissions the signed-in person has in the web app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add origami.publica.la to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add origami.publica.la to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://origami.publica.la/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the origami.publica.la MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: origami.publica.la lists 15 MCP tools, including create-upload, finalize-publication, get-account, get-account-usage, get-download-link, get-publication, get-publication-reader, get-run-report, get-tool-run, list-publication-files, list-publications, and list-tool-runs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to origami.publica.la?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to origami.publica.la in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
origami.publica.la requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
origami.publica.la is developed by publica.la. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
